results.title: Le Tour 1991
results.brief_description: The Tour de France is the world’s premier cycle race. In 1991 it was held over 23 days and travelled through 3,940 kms of the most spectacular French countryside culminating in the traditional last stage ride into Paris. The two videos contain the highlights of the race, interviews with top participants, descriptions of each stage of the race, a stage by stage update on the leadership table and comments by some of the fifteen million spectators.

results.title: Le Tango stupefiant
results.brief_description: This is an imaginary cabaret where songs from the past unexpectedly meet. It celebrates with irony, tenderness and sophistication, broken hearts and mysterious rugs. Simply staged and beautifully lit, the film brings together a range of music written between 1900 and 1940 by composers and lyricists as diverse as Satie, Schoenberg, Brecht and Weill, Benjamin and W.H. Auden.

results.title: Le Quebec as seen by Cartier-Bresson
results.brief_description: The photographs of Henri Cartier-Bresson were the first ever to be displayed in the Louvre, Paris. In this film the world famous photographer turns his lens on the Quebec scene, finding there the same fascination with form and movement that gives his work a mark of individuality. Here, in town and country, are young people, old people, streets and fences, homes and edifices captured in a moment of time to give a composite representation of the world of Quebec.

results.title: Le Nozze di Figaro: opera comica in quattro atti
results.creator_credit: Peter Sellars, Mediascope, Osterreichischer Rundfunk-Fernsehen and Plaza Media
results.brief_description: A comic opera in four acts, music by Mozart and libretto by Lorenzo Da Ponte. This performance, directed by Peter Sellars, is set in modern times, in Trump Tower, Manhattan, 52 floors above Fifth Avenue. The action takes place in a single day, where love, fidelity and loyalty are all put to the test. Features singers Sanford Sylvan (Figaro), Jeanne Ommerle (Susanna), James Maddalena (Count Almaviva), Jayne West (Countess Almaviva), Susan Larson (Cherubino), Lynn Torgove (Barbarina), Frank Kelley (Don Basilio), David Evitts (Doctor Bartolo), Sue Ellen Kuzma (Marcellina), Herman Hildebrand (Antonio), William Cotton (Don Curzio), and the Arnold-Schonberg-Chor. Also features the Wiener Symphoniker conducted by Craig Smith. This co-production was originally staged for the Pepsico Summerfare Festival, The International Performing Arts Festival of the State University of New York at Purchase, by director Christopher Hunt. Sung in Italian, no English subtitles.

results.title: Le Meme bateau
results.brief_description: A summary of the work UNICEF is doing to give all children an equal chance in life. Using animated cut-out cartoon style, this charming but pointed allegory tells the story of four children in the same boat. Two from rich countries have shiny oars to row their boat through life’s waters, while the two from poorer countries have only broken oars

results.title: Le Jongleur = The Juggler
results.creator_credit: Thomas Vamos, Helene Verrier and ONF | NFB
results.brief_description: A juggler opens his magic box and takes out three balls. The audience marvels at his dexterity until one ball escapes. The mutinous ball assumes magical properties as it draws the juggler into a series of adventures with many levels of meaning: appearance, fantasy and love. The spectator’s age and subjective impressions determine the interpretation of this non-narrated tale.
